info.background_text:
Poet of the Black Rose.
An elite agent from the SS Justitia, maintaining a cold demeanor in any situation while also preserving a delicate, feminine sensitivity. She enjoys writing poetry and dislikes talking about herself except when it’s within the prose she's writing.
